Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted “home ground of South Melbourne” (the team) as meaning the suburb South Melbourne, ignoring corroborating evidence that Lake Oval is in Albert Park (the inner suburb 3 km south of the CBD). This conflation led to choosing the wrong suburb despite sources explicitly stating “Lake Oval, Albert Park.”
